title: Integral quotient reduction with normalized unit and positive Kummer target
statement: Let l be a prime, T a scheme with l invertible in its global sections, and k the Kummer data of [def-sp-tower-class-systems]. There exist an integral quotient-system Reduction r [def-sp-tower-class-reduction], an R_l(T)-module system M [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients], an isomorphism from its underlying abelian system to the actual positive-exponent roots tower, an isomorphism from r applied to the integer unit to the quotient coefficient unit, and an isomorphism from r applied to the constant units system shifted by one to M shifted by two. The source comparison has adjunct integerGenerator; the target comparison has adjunct the positive Kummer connecting morphism of k, with the displayed exact-single and shift-addition comparisons in targetNormalization. No scalar extension, finite Chern comparison or tensor/Hom twist is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_normalizedKummerReduction (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (k : Kummer l T) :
    (fun R : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1} ↦
    ∃ (r : Reduction T R) (M : Systems T R)
      (i : r.forget.F.obj M ≅ roots l T)
      (a : r.derived.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj (integers T)) ≅
        unit T R)
      (b : r.derived.obj (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj
        (units T))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T R) 0).obj M)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧),
      r.model.sourceNormalization a (integerGenerator T R r.forget) ∧
      r.model.targetNormalization (ShortComplex.mk k.inclusion k.power k.zero)
        k.exact b i) (Rrings l T)
